name: T3_append_only_ledger

provenance.source: Card Model Research Handover (2026-10-22), sections 8, 11 and the theorems the formal core needs

statement: Appending to the ledger never moves an atom; reading a content through the ledger is an injective homomorphism of products, gcd, lcm and divisibility; the reading does not change as the ledger grows, and agrees along any chain of versions (the directed union).
